name: Theta | The Goddess of Creation
bio:
The serene town of Pokémon was once home to two extraordinary beings: Theta and Gamma. From birth, Theta was unique—a fusion, though her powers remained dormant, rendering her unable to harness any of her inherent abilities. Orion, a celestial observer, watched over her with great interest as she navigated this limitation with remarkable creativity and resilience. 

One fateful day, Gamma's mischievous pranks led to Theta being banished from their hometown. Misfortune was often blamed on her due to her unusual nature, casting a shadow of misfortune over her. Orion, intrigued by Theta’s ingenious adaptations and unyielding spirit, bestowed upon her the power of creation. With this divine gift, she became the Goddess of Creation, capable of crafting and merging universes according to her whims.

name: Delta | The God of Destruction
bio:
This Adult that has adapted to hunt at night on the tops of volcanoes and high mountains near the desert where the sky helps to camouflage itself, can be territorial with creatures that disturb the peace of this area. His venom evolved to be neurotoxic and can cause severe disorientation in his victims. 
Ruthless to all that challenged him he was mad with power. Alone in the universe with nobody 
Delta is the God of Destruction

name: Orion | The Observer
bio: Creator of all. Now just an observer of the universe.

name: Gamma Vandal Maelstrom | The God of Chaos
bio: Gamma, the brother of Theta, was a force of chaos from his earliest days. His unpredictable nature often led to both amusement and trouble in their small town leading to the banishment of his sister Theta. After pleas from Gamma for Orion to not leave him alone after taking his sister, Orion took interest in Gamma's chaotic influence and granted him lesser creative power of his sister, yet some destructive capabilities, transforming him into the God of Chaos. With his newfound power, Gamma reveled in the freedom to sow discord. With Theta’s newly crafted worlds, he decided to play a role, adding layers of unpredictability and dynamic energy to the realms she created together.

name: Kuromori | The Goddess of Population
bio: Kuromori (aka. Tina) was released from the Distortion World by Theta to become the newest God of the universe.

name: Knox | Follower of Theta
bio: A traveler of the lands spreading news of Theta

name: Resha
bio: Following the events involving Crimson and Flumf, she traveled with her sisters through The Legendary Palace to travel to The Roslom Region. Upon arrival, she decided to head off on her own path and since gone missing within that world, leaving a void in the lives of Kyu and Zeku.

name: Zeku | Powder Reject
bio: The youngest of the sisters, Zeku has stepped into a role of strength to support her older sibling, Kyu. After Resha went missing in The Roslom Region, Zeku took it upon herself to stay strong for both Kyu and the memory of their family. To help keep Kyu's spirits up, she adopted a rebellious personality in the form of Flumf—a trait she eventually grew to love and integrated into her music production. During their time in the new dimension, she would find Korumak's Alternative Collection. There she would meet and formed a deep bond with Victoria, finding in them new allies and friends who understand the weight of their journey.

name: Victoria | Victory Palace
bio: Victoria is a member of Korumak's Alternative Collection (KAC). After meeting Zeku and Kyu in The Roslom Region, she formed an incredibly close sisterly bond with them. While she is not part of their original family, she has become a vital source of cheerfulness for the two sisters, often acting as a lighthearted anchor during their travels. She is widely considered the most cheerful person in the group.

name: Vincent Bitti
bio: Vincent is an entrepreneur in multiple industries, and the current owner of Korumak's Alternative Collection (KAC). Having recently gained ownership from Korumak, he rebranded the label to his liking. Later meeting Galileo, to provide the funds to open a bar on the Isle, leaving him in charge of bartending there. Latest achievement was offering a deal with Maverick, signing him into the brand with other talents featured.

name: Tobias
bio: Tobias, the brother of Moxie is the brash member of Korumak's Alternative Collection (KAC).

name: Moxie
bio: Moxie, the sister of Tobias is the sliest member of Korumak's Alternative Collection (KAC).

name: Flumf
bio:
Flumf is deranged and mentally unstable, characterized by messy fur and an erratic temperament. He always looked up to his older Zekrom Brother as a role model. After their brother sacrificed himself during a battle against shadow creatures, Crimson blamed Flumf for the loss and sought bloody revenge.

Left defeated, nearing death he was saved by Resha, who fused with him to sustain his life. After years of recovery, he eventually forced her to defuse, leading to a period of mayhem that drew the attention of both Crimson and Theta. Sensing each other's presences, Flumf sought refuge and safety with Gira, who provided sanctuary within his Distortion World. He knew he would have to reface his Brother soon....

name: Flumf (Altered Form)
bio:
Prolong exposure within The Distortion World transformed Flumf into an altered form that is unnatural for his species. While seeking refuge from Crimson's rampage, Gira provided a sanctuary where Flumf could hide and train. With the help of Benjamin J Wildclaw and Gira, they worked to create a new collar for Flumf to fit his new look.

Unlike his previous state of derangement, time spent in the Distortion World has allowed Flumf to mature significantly; he is becoming increasingly mentally stable and composed. While he still carries the weight of his past—rooted in the fusion with Resha, he aims to finish what started.

name: Crimson
bio: After Crimson heard of his brother's death, he blamed Flumf for it, and sought for revenge. Nearly killing Flumf to then leave him to die on his own. Unknown to him Resha found him on the brink of death, and decided to fuse with Flumf. Believing he was the last of his family, he would go on a massacre for domination of the world. Years past until he felt a connection to his brother awaken again. Now with the confirmation that his brother is alive. He aims to finish what started.

name: Gira
bio: Close friends with Resha, Flumf, and Tina. He provided a safe space for Resha within his Distortion World, offering her a place to visit and unwind whenever she needed it. He was responsible for creating the "Distortion Collars" that allowed Resha to travel between her realm and his own. During Crimson's rampage in the overworld, Gira provided refuge for Flumf; together with Benjamin J Wildclaw, they'd create a new collar for Flumf (Altered Form), and Gira would then train Flumf for his upcoming final battle with his brother.

name: Tina
bio: Tina served as the overhead leader of the sanctioned area she shared with Gira. While maintaining her position, she was secretly visited by Theta to receive tasks designed to test and expand her influence over others. These trials eventually led to her promotion into a cosmic god, known as Kuromori.

name: Eugene
bio: Eugene is a caring sweetheart who takes on the persona of Maverick the Rockstar by night. While he is mostly shy towards anyone outside his close friend group, his rockstar persona is energetic, serious, and rude—but only as an act towards fans.

name: Maverick | The Rockstar
bio: Maverick is the rockstar persona of Eugene. A caring sweetheart by day, and an egotistical performer by night. While Eugene is mostly shy towards anyone outside his close friend group, Maverick is pretty energetic, serious, and rude, but only as an act towards fans. His stage career taught him how to stand up and protect those he loves by any means necessary.

name: Eros Lovecore | The Mayor
bio: Mayor of The Isle, sharing love and positivity

name: Galileo
bio: Galileo came from a distance region to possibly start his own business. Hear a popular Cafe was selling their business, so he took the opportunity, and purchased it himself. With no friends on The Isle, and not used to their local customs he got all his news from the in-house tv, but would soon quickly began to learn from 5 frequent customers.

name: Rocko Stoneson | The Protege
bio: With a dream of being famous, him and his close friend Luna lived their simple lives together with a basic job until a run in with Eugene (Maverick) changed their lives. Now as Maverick's pupil, learning the ways of life as a future Rockstar under Korumak's Alternative Collection (KAC)

name: Luna
bio: Luna never had a family growing up, finding a sibling like bond with Rocko, sticking close at all opportunities. Living a simple life until meet Eugene taking both of them under his wing to provide her the family she always wanted.

name: Nova
bio: Abandoned at birth alongside her brother Tyler, Nova grew on her own surviving how she could. Managing to work out her life she settled on become a P.E teacher in The Isle school. She mated to Elliot, and is mother to Gabriel
extra: Nova and him were split as kids since she was caught by a trainer to end up having a relationship with her trainer pokephilia but they decided to go their separate ways to avoid getting into too much trouble (thats a different story) which ended up with her finding her long lost brother Tyler

name: Gabriel
bio: Gabriel is the only child of Nova and Elliot, two of the strongest mons on the Isle. He's a bully in school but loves his sister, strawberries, and is a friend to foreign creatures

name: Blaster | The Detective
bio: Blaster's been for the people all his life. Greeting any newcomers to the Isle, and making many friends along the way. He has seen many things that some should never see, but made it his goal so nobody would have to see it. After being hired by Apostle Wake, it now made his goals possible to serve and protect the people from harm. Making friends with Tyler taught him to not let hardship bring him down, and to have as much fun as possible while doing what he likes. Now he's been called to action to hunt down the elusive target that stole the Ventus Maelstrom Staff.

name: David Wildclaw | The Champion
bio: David was adopted by Benjamin after losing his parents in The Great Firestorm on The Isle. Now the strongest on The Isle and is the founder of The Guardians, influencing majority of the decisions for the safety of the inhabitants living on The Isle. He past the leadership on to Hereford, now partaking in The Isle tournaments as a famous entertainer.

name: Tyler
bio:
Abandoned at birth alongside his sister Nova, both separated during their childhood. Tyler was raised by a group of [INSERT] until receiving an anonymous letter on the location of his sister.  He managed to pick up a job babysitting for Hereford thanks to his step brother's connection to Elliot. While babysitting he gain the attention of Benjamin, who would take him in to train him along side David. After hearing of his training, Hereford would invite him to join the Guardians. One day after babysitting Tyler would spot his future mate. Later having a Cyndaquil son named Joshua, then to adopt an Zorua years later. 
 
Receiving intense training from David and Benjamin, Tyler is set to becoming the next Champion of The Isle.

name: Apostle Wake | The Sheriff
bio: One of the three ancient protectors of The Isle, Apostle would form the earliest police force. Later hiring Blaster as his new Detective. He now isolates his self in his work, as Sheriff of The Isle

name: Caspian
bio: Caspian is one of the three ancient protectors of The Isle. Constantly seen relaxing, eating apples on their mountain. Used to mostly care for themself, until meeting a special Mew that would change their morals for the better. Now they are always watching the Island from a distance, only to appearing if it is in danger. Last sighted during "The Great Firestorm", helping Benjamin putting out the fire while he saved the fleeing citizens. Myths been formed after their first sighting, never to be seen again in public. Many attempts to search for them, but could never find a trace. Only a few knows of their existence being true, but only Apostle Wake knows of their resting location.

name: Elliot | Guardian Strength
bio: One of the three Guardian leaders. Elliot brings the physical strength to the trio, being Hereford's second in command, mates with Nova, and father of Gabriel.

name: Hereford | Guardian Leader
bio: One of the three Guardian leaders. Hereford is the leader of The Guardians. He's still has assassin skills so his strength more or less matters but being a leader has to make you know your stuff heh

name: Kulta | Guardian Bookkeeper
bio: One of the three Guardian leaders. Kulta brings strategic planning to the trio, being Hereford's main strategist.

name: Plume
bio:
She was the leader of a Gryphon clan and love research and gems before theta brought her to this universe 
she is curious and analytical 
Likes shiny things

name: Benjamin J. Wildclaw
bio:
Benjamin was once a prominent industrialist and innovator in The Druron Kingdom, known for his laboratory where he mass-produced unique inventions. After being kidnapped by Kenna and experimented on to become a mindless super-weapon, he escaped with his mind intact but plagued by uncontrollable rage blackouts. He fled to The Isle to live in hiding, eventually becoming a guardian figure after helping save citizens during "The Great Firestorm" alongside Caspian. Accompanied by his loyal owl companion, Darwin—who serves as a vital anchor and stabilizer during his volatile episodes——Now living in seclusion, Ben serves as a mentor, adopting David and training Tyler to become the next champions of the island. 

Following his adoption of David, Benjamin's intellectual curiosity led him to uncover ancient books of myths and legends. Utilizing his immense engineering knowledge, he successfully constructed a portal to the Distortion World. It was through this gateway that he made contact with the deities Gira and Tina, establishing a profound connection between the mortal world of The Isle and the supernatural realms beyond. Soon working directly with Gira to engineer a new collar for Flumf before returning to his land.

name: Keith
bio:
Keith, an Imperial Dragon, is a pretty jolly, naïve, and caring guy. A devastating conflict in his past caused his family to split apart, leaving him adrift. Seeking a new beginning, he travels across the world with the hope of finding a place where he can truly belong and find his purpose again. One thing is for sure: he'll never abandon his doll friend, Fern. 

Seeking a fresh start away from the turmoil of his past, Keith journeys to The Isle, drawn by its potential as a land of opportunity for those looking to rebuild. While there, he keeps his past connections a secret as he navigates the local landscape. He eventually meets and forms a bond with Theodore, who becomes a key ally in his journey. At the suggestion of Lora, both he and Theodore join the newly developing The Scouts team, which already includes Thomas, Lora, and Solstice.

While on the team the group would form a bond and uncover the atrocities that Reaper was creating behind the scene on The Isle. After an attack by Reaper they would be saved by Solstice and would learn her ties with Reaper forming an rift between the group, but it would be Keith's compassion and determination that held the group together forming his status as the unofficial leader of the group, leading them to the defeat of Reaper and his clan.

Keith, now mates with Theodore, is the official leader of his team in The Pathfinder Guild recruiting new members.

name: Keith (Older)
bio: Keith the Diamond Hakamo-o is the creator of Acryliccs Arts. He's a pretty jolly, naïve, and caring guy. Used to living with Resha's family, becoming besties with Kyu and Victoria, and like a little brother to Zeku. The massive fight between Flumf and Crimson, would caused the family to split apart. Resha would give Keith the ownership of KAC before removing all contacts. Keith currently travels across the world in hopes of finding her again, but one thing for sure is that he'll never abandon his substitute doll friend, Fern. Now he finds himself on The Isle, meeting the locals while keeping his connections to the legendries a secret. He would eventually meet and form a relationship with Theodore, who would later help Keith in his adventures in finding his caretaker.

name: Solstice
bio:
Solstice’s strength was both her blessing and her burden within the Ashen Veil Tribe. While celebrated as top of her class in the tribe - a title earned through relentless training alongside Silvia and Brite – she often felt isolated by her raw power, struggling to reconcile it with the tribe's emphasis on balance and harmony. Their graduation was abruptly halted by the return of Litih, an exiled dark mage whose defeat required all their combined skill. Following the ceremony’s conclusion, Solstice chose a path diverging from her peers, seeking solitude on a remote Isle where she could connect with her own kind. 

However, survival demanded compromise, and she reluctantly accepted a position as an assassin under the ruthless Lucario leader, Reaper. The weight of each life taken chipped away at her soul until she encountered Krow, a young Grovyle whose vulnerability resonated deeply within her. Unable to reconcile Reaper’s brutality with her conscience, Solstice defied his orders, rescuing Krow and plotting an escape. 

Seeking refuge and purpose, Solstice infiltrated a newly forming Scouts clan, where she met Keith, Theodore, and Lora – individuals who would become invaluable allies. Together, they exposed Reaper’s operation, transforming the Scouts into The Pathfinder Guild, an organization dedicated to exploration, protection, and justice. Solstice now embraces a life of peace and camaraderie within the Guild, finally finding belonging and using her strength for good – a far cry from the solitary assassin she once was.

name: Elias
bio: Elias is partners with Koa in The Pathfinder Guild.

name: Koa
bio: Koa is partners with Elias in The Pathfinder Guild.

name: Krow
bio: Krow joined Reaper's Clan at a young age thinking it would be ticket to becoming the strongest Grovyle on the Isle, but instead was shown that wasn't Reaper's plan. He was forced to kill innocents. Out of guilt. and trauma, he would stay in hiding from Reaper's Clan over the years, but would eventually stumble across Gabriel.

name: Girabsol
bio:
Following Tina's orders to kill whoever won the battle between brothers. However, Flumf unexpectedly lived and won, forcing Gira to follow orders and kill his best friend. 

Ashamed and enraged by what he was forced to do, he abandoned Tina and the Distortion World, leaving everyone else to find an attempt of correcting his mistake by resurrecting Flumf. He would travel to The Legendary Palace as a way to find his solution in a different world; after exploring, he realized he'd needed a better disguise and used his Griseous Orb to create an entirely new form for himself in order to find what he seek in secret.

name: Milo Heartwood
bio:
Born within the confines of a secluded town in the The Druron Kingdom, Milo was placed under the protection of Vulkor following the request of his parents during a time of great upheaval for his species. While he lived a peaceful life on a farm, he remained largely unaware of his true heritage as one of the Crystal Hearted Dragons. The local villagers were well-acquainted with his kind and trusting nature; though it often led him into trouble, they took their vow to keep him safe and isolated within the town's borders very seriously.

As he grew, Milo’s curiosity regarding the world beyond the village sparked a sense of rebellion. He frequently attempted to venture out, but was consistently caught and cautioned by those trying to shield him from the dangers of his true nature. 

One day, while working on the farm, he encountered an injured Kobold. Despite their initial caution, a bond formed between them, and Milo took the creature as his companion, naming it Nobuku. Their relationship was tested when Vulkor discovered the outsider and attempted to separate them for the safety of both parties. During a confrontation regarding the restrictions placed upon him, Milo spoke out against his confinement. Recognizing his growth, Vulkor finally revealed the truth: he was not merely a resident of the town, but a survivor of the Crystal Hearted Dragons.

name: ████████ | Nobuku
bio: Nobuku is a Kobold who was originally created as a laboratory experiment by the scientist Kenna. Seeking liberation from the modifications imposed upon her, she escaped her confinement in a desperate quest for freedom. During her flight, she sought refuge on a secluded farm, where she encountered Milo, a sheltered Crystal Hearted Dragon living under the guardianship of Vulkor. Despite her initial distrust, a deep bond formed between the two; it was Milo who bestowed the name Nobuku upon her.

name: Vulkor
bio:
He raised Milo from the request of Milo's parents during the genocide of The Crystal Hearted species executed by the Mad King Zorumaki. Vulkor was a rebellion, battling against the King's army as he was friends with majority of them. In the heat of battle he would get struck by a powerful blast from the opposing forces the would permanently burn and blind the right side of his face.

Eldrin Heartwood (Milo's father) would jump in to rescue the fallen Nightfury, getting them both out of the battle to escape to a secluded town they've been refugees in. This town has been secretly housing some of The Crystal Hearted Dragons from the Kingdom, but with the ongoing battle it was only a matter of time till the war reached it. Eldrin, while caring for his wounded friend saw how dangerous it was for him and his species to remain in this town. With his mate recently giving birth, he decided to take charge and rally the remaining of his kin in town, persuading everyone that it'll be best if they all found another place in the to shelter till the ongoing war is over. They began their departure, Eldrin was ready to give his long friend Vulkor a goodbye, but something in his mind snapped. He left and would soon return with an egg.

Eldrin would entrust Vulkor and town to give his kid a proper life one without him needing to hide away in a cave. He wanted his kid to live as a normal dragon without knowledge of his heritage till he was ready. As dangerous as it was to leave their not even new born baby behind, Eldrin believed it'll allow their species to live on in the long run. Vulkor accepted the offer and promised to put his life on the line if to protect the kid.

Soon The Crystal Hearted Dragons would depart with nobody in the world but one, knowing where to locate them when the time is right. Vulkor not experienced with fatherhood and would have to adapt quickly as when the egg hatched. It was small defenseless hatchling he would call, Milo.

name: Zorumaki | The Mad King
bio:
When the war reached its breaking point, King Aurith—sovereign of the Dragon Kingdom—opted to end his people’s campaign to preserve what remained. This choice was not accepted by all; Zorumaki, a general within the dragon armies, rejected the call for peace and launched a brutal crusade against The Crystal Hearted Dragons, claiming the life of King Aurith as his first victim.

Following the fall of the king, Zorumaki turned his aggression toward Anthromorph territory. Although the ensuing conflict was fierce, the dragon forces were eventually repelled by the advanced technology of the Anthro nations. The war reached its definitive conclusion when a later monarch successfully captured and imprisoned Zorumaki within a deep cell beneath the earth's surface.

With their primary threat neutralized, the land wars ended, leading to the unification of the four kingdoms under the rule of the Anthromorphs. While history remembers Zorumaki as the architect of the tragedy that decimated The Crystal Hearted Dragons, it remains a secret that several members of the species remain in hiding.

name: Imaginary Obelisk | The False God
bio: A new species arose from the Ancients-Hoomans. After the final ascension of the old benefactors within the depths near Twelve Moons. With their studies of old pearls and scriptures, the hoomans took it upon themselves to create their own God-Imaginary Obelisk. What meant to be an homage to the past civilization was met with mixed reactions before the remaining Ancients left following Twelve Moons' cryogenic incident. Now, Imaginary Obelisk's task is to serve and protect his citizens, hiding away the hoomans from the outside lands of The Druron Kingdom. Leaving the outside world to believe the species to be extinct.

name: IO-X000: Stormpaw | Sour
bio:
«Iteration Log: The First Elemental Bio-Manipulation»  
Experiment ID: IO-X000  
Designation: Stormpaw 
Purpose: Evaluate the viability of elemental attunement in organic species. Preliminary findings indicate stable and promising energy modulation within the subject. 

Notes: The subject appeared with a Slugcat, initially presented as domesticated, evidenced by the presence of a harness secured upon them. Attempts at removal result in spontaneous electrical discharge, indicating significant distress. It appears the subject exhibits an emotional attachment to the object; otherwise, they pose no apparent threat. 
 
- Imaginary Obelisk, Localized

name: IO-X001: Aetherpaw
bio:
«Iteration Log: The First Successor Bio-Creation»  
Experiment ID: IO-X001  
Designation: Aetherpaw 
Purpose: To develop a successor to IO-X000 capable of harnessing elemental energy from power crystals. The subject represents a potential solution for restoring Local Iterator Twelve Moons following their cryogenic incident. 

Notes: Subject was designed after a slugcat that now frequently visits my chamber. Subject currently possesses access only to the electrical element derived from the crystal embedded within IO-X000. Additional elemental crystals must be located to unlock further capabilities of its uncharged power crystal. The subject exhibits no apparent vulnerability to external environmental hazards; however, it demonstrates resistance to most directives. It is unclear whether this behavior constitutes defiance or a form of mockery. 

- Imaginary Obelisk, Localized

name: IO-X002: Titanhide | The Failed Experiment
bio:
«Iteration Log: Failure»  
Experiment ID: IO-X002  
Designation: Titanhide  
Purpose: Designed as a defensive construct intended to safeguard the citizen population upon ██████. The subject exhibits a robust exterior with ████████████ capabilities and possesses powerful jaws capable of incapacitating hostile entities. Its intelligence is estimated to rival that of ████████████, drawing inspiration from the Druronian dragons. 

Notes: The subject poses a significant threat to all known lifeforms-a mistake. Its advanced intelligence is evidenced by complex communication patterns despite fragmented vocalization. The target was not terminated and has subsequently taken refuge beneath my vary structure in the old factorial district of Ironmill Works. 

New observations show that the creature has formed an unusual bond with IO-X003, and a deep hatred for IO-X000. Though these studies have been observed through older Overseers, the subjects do appear to be communicating with one another upon close examination; however, too close proximity of the Overseers would result in enraging the beast. This unexpected form of social interaction makes the most sense, so leaving them undisturbed is fine for now. I will work on replacing Overseers #173 and Overseer #096 with a 600 series to monitor conversations and ensure they are deemed safe for further interactions. 
 
- Imaginary Obelisk, Localized
extra:
If you see the Never-Corpse, you're already dead - you just don't know it yet. 

Even the Rain can't wash it away. 

Obelisk made it, but the world paid for it.

name: Sweet
bio: Sweet is a pet of the mad scientist, Kenna. Raised since birth making her loyal to her commands. During a chase to capture Milo and Nobuku, Sweet would sadly perish in the pursuit leaving just Sour.

name: Sour
bio:
Sour is a pet of the mad scientist, Kenna. Raised since birth making him loyal to her commands. During a chase to capture Milo and Nobuku, Kenna and Sour would be confronted by Milo's companions on a Cliffside. Falling to the rushing river below. Sour would survive, but his owner wouldn't leaving him alone into the wilderness. 

After exploring the nearby forest he would be unknowingly stalked by Brite. She would jump to attack him but his domesticated instinct would have him submit instead of retaliate. Brite would take note of the strange Lizard and choose to make it her companion on her mission towards the local Superstructure. 

Once they make it to the structure to learn about the supercomputer running it inside, Imaginary Obelisk. IO would find intrigued in the creatures that managed to climb his structure and enter his chamber. That's when he thought of experimenting with creatures. He would make Sour his first test subject by infusing the power crystal on his harness with their body. 

After that success he would instruct Brite to steal a dormant power crystal from his city above. With that artifact, he would later create Aetherpaw.

name: Brite | The Warrior
bio:
Brite’s existence is linked to The Ashen Veil tribe, an enigmatic society of albino females dwelling in isolation within the Druron Kingdom. For generations, these females have honed their skills as killers, a tradition passed down through rigorous training and steeped in ancient rituals. Brite was raised from birth to embody this legacy, enduring relentless drills and mastering deadly techniques alongside her classmates, Silvia and Solstice. Their graduation ceremony—a culmination of years of dedication—was tragically disrupted by the sudden reappearance of Lilith, an exiled student rumored to be a user of Dark Magic. 

The defeat of Lilith left Brite grappling with conflicting emotions: pride in her tribe’s strength and a lingering unease about the implications of Dark Magic plaging other parts of the world. Seeking answers and a purpose beyond the confines of tradition, she journeyed East towards a region surrounded by impenetrable overgrowth. Tales circulated throughout the Druron Kingdom spoke of those who dared to enter never returning, attributing their fate to possible use of dark magic. Driven by a desire to protect others from the unseen dangers and perhaps find a way to reconcile her skills with a more peaceful existence, Brite has embarked on a perilous quest—one that may lead her to confront not only external threats but also the very foundations of her beliefs. 

«Iteration Log: Druronian Tribal Slugcat»
Designation: The Warrior 
Notes: This slugcat is peculiar; she doesn't seem to have come from either the City or the Slugcat Colony below. From the markings I can trace, it originates from a tribe in Druron. It’s strange that this creature managed to wander so far and even climb my very structure. She could learn some manners though, but perhaps I could utilize this species as a solution for a friend. 

- Imaginary Obelisk, Localized

name: The Beast Tamer | Matt
bio: A cautious, solitary tan slugcat living near a scavenger community. He is resourceful, observant, and possesses a degree of familiarity with local scavengers and landmarks like Imaginary Obelisk. His current goal is to assist Rivulet and Spearmaster in finding their way home.

name: Rivulet
bio: From an alternate world, Rivulet found herself waking in a shelter in front of Matt along with her closest friend, Spearmaster whom she affectionately calls "Speary." She was transported to this world during a storm of
origin. While her high-energy spirit often leads their adventures, she remains deeply protective of those she considers family. Despite being
with Spearmaster they are often suspected to be mates by outsiders. Currently, she is focused on establishing a permanent home for their group with Matt.

name: Spearmaster
bio: Engineered by the Iterator Seven Red Suns to deliver vital messages, Spearmaster was transported from an alternate universe along with his closest companion, Rivulet. After waking in this new world, he met Matt soon forming a bond. His hunting style is often described as oddly feral, a trait that Rivulet finds overwhelming but accepts as part of his nature. While he is a slugcat of few words, his role as a protector and anchor for those around him is well-established. He frequently endures the nickname "Speary" from Rivulet, despite finding it simplistic; they are often mistaken for mates by others and are currently working with Matt to find a stable home.

name: Kyu | Color Sorrow
bio: As the eldest of the sisters, Kyu is deeply haunted by the past. She was devastated by the loss of Flumf's Zekrom brother and remained reclusive due to the unwanted attention from Crimson. After fleeing their home realm for The Roslom Region, she has been consumed by a profound sadness over the disappearance of her middle sister, Resha. While she struggles to stay present, she relies on the bond she shares with Zeku and Victoria to keep going.

name: IO-X003: Ignisoul | The Guardian of Light
bio:
«Iteration Log: Guardian of Light» 
Experiment ID: IO-X003 
Designation: Ignisoul 
Purpose: This experiment was designed as the successor to the failed subject, Titanhide. The Guardian of Light is intended to properly protect all life forms within the surrounding area, possessing numerous abilities including Grove Revival (produces a radius to heal itself and other creatures), Echo Projections (creates short-lived, semi-solid light clones of itself), and Harmonic Resonance (generates sound waves at tunable frequencies, reducing aggression in other creatures; tested on a Scavenger)—all to further its designated goal.

Notes: The subject has maintained its physical form; however, subsequent observations indicate a tendency for progressive color changes dependent on actions. This is concerning, as the subject appears to be evolving into a corrupted version of itself when attempting to heal other life forms. Furthermore, it demonstrates an accelerated learning rate exceeding initial projections. Inquiry: Is this behavior indicative of loneliness, or simply a manifestation of heightened efficiency? The introduction of designated entities—Stormpaw or Aetherpaw—may prove instrumental in establishing appropriate social interactions. 

- Imaginary Obelisk, Localized
extra: I regret resorting to using my Experiment's names. I have developed a concern for their well-being.

name: IO-X003-A: Ignisoul (Corrupted) | The Guardian of Light
bio:
«Iteration Log: Guardian of Light» 
Experiment ID: IO-X003-A 
Designation: Ignisoul '(Corrupted)' 
Purpose: The Guardian of Light is intended to properly protect all life forms within the surrounding area; however, observations suggest this subject represents a corrupted version of the expected outcome. The creature possesses abilities distinct from its regular form, including Soul-Link (briefly possessing other creatures), Symbiotic Charging (draining residual energy from other creatures), and Triggered Overglow (a last resort of energy expanding into a radiant explosion, blinding and burning unprotected organisms. subject loses its form). 

Notes: In this corrupted state, it tends to perform the opposite of its intended purpose, though it never resorts to killing—perhaps indicating a core design limitation preventing further escalation. It still follows directives given while in this form but does display increased aggression. 

- Imaginary Obelisk, Localized

name: Mossweaver
bio:
Mossweaver lives in Skyline Ruins. A long abandoned city left by ancient civilization now inhabitant by other Slugcats and Scavengers. 

She's mates with a Scavenger named Kuruk. With involvement of Artificer (who hates Scavengers btw) their relationship managed to change her view point of the species for the better because great friends (some time acquaintances XD). Both would later adopt Tharn as theirs after a series of events. 

She's good at medical practices but doesn't particularly work in the fields either. Her name comes from how her fur resembles moss and her tail draging dirt and twigs as she walks (dw she keeps herself well groomed)

name: Tharn | The Raider
bio: A young Slugcat leader of a Scavenger group called The Raiders. His goal is to show his old colony proof of a safer life on top of The Rainmaker.

name: Flint the Librarian | Dylan the Hitman
bio:
Flint (Dylan if in disguise) 
Flint is a skilled and trained assassin, along side with ████████████ since they were young. But he moved to big city and changed his name in day to Dylan, and work as a librarian and part time art teacher, while still working as a hired hitman/assassin at night, in hope that they could get a better life in the new place instead of being an assassin like they usually did.

name: Korumak
bio:
Korumak, Founder of Korumak's Records, later Korumak's Alternative Collection. He created the label to find new talent across the world to boost their popularity. After years of fame and money he determined that lifestyle wasn't for him and transferred ownership to Vincent Bitti. 

Now Korumak lives his days supporting his town's community. One day meeting a lone individual in an alleyway, Kai, they would form a great bond, becoming close partners over time.

name: Kai
bio: He was found street by Korumak

name: Lightness of Golden Beads & The Cartographer
bio: Cartographer is almost blind, a condition that has haunted it since birth; because of this, it never saw the faces of its relatives clearly. It is omnivorous but practical, often preferring what is easiest to obtain. Following an incident during a storm where it sought shelter in a pile of trash, shards of debris pierced and became fused into its body; while these 'scars' are rarely felt now, they occasionally serve as a defense in the event of sudden danger. After accidentally finding Lightness of Golden Beads, the two formed a bond so strong that Cartographer's family moved to live nearby. It suggests using robo-eyes to assist with territory scans, and enjoys adventures, traveling, and the occasional joy of annoying others in local groups.

name: Kuruk
bio: He is a kind Scavenger that is trying to help Artificer overcome her hatred of his species. When his mate was kidnapped he became more agitated and frustrated but is still trying to care for Artificer.
